actions: Verified CPO's owner-partition-only ZeRO-3 mask-gradient injection and non-ZeRO full-replica injection directly from the pinned trainer.
Verified public 2B CPO uses ZeRO-2 while 4B/8B CPO use ZeRO-3 offload, default mask_lambda is 100, and the paper environment specifies eight H100 GPUs, PyTorch 2.8.0 and DeepSpeed 0.16.4.

Verified DeepSpeed v0.16.4 exact tag, post-accumulate reduction hook path, __avg_scatter_grads reduce-scatter call and world-size pre-division; verified PyTorch 2.8 official hook ordering places CPO's Tensor hook before DeepSpeed's post-accumulate hook.

Derived the 1/W regularizer attenuation and same 1/W rank-mean logging attenuation under the public standard DP execution; did not claim a live eight-GPU reproduction or bind paper tables to this exact commit.
material_findings: Under the public eight-rank DP topology, current CPO ZeRO-3 owner-only regularizer injection is averaged to 1/8 of the intended replicated regularizer magnitude; default lambda 100 is therefore lambda-equivalent to 12.5 relative to the non-ZeRO-3 semantics, all else equal.
The public 2B CPO path uses ZeRO-2 while 4B and 8B use ZeRO-3, so the current release's cross-size comparison is not a clean same-effective-lambda comparison.
ZeRO-3 mask_loss logging has the same 1/W scale under the standard DP partition, which can make the attenuation appear internally consistent rather than obvious.
This is source-level algebra from pinned public code and official hook/reduction semantics, not an observed training failure or proof that the published tables used the exact current release.
exact_next_action: Rotate to sealed C24 long_horizon or failure_evidence; prioritize an exact raw implementation or quantitative reliability claim not already source-bound in C22/C23.
